status_summary: OPM awarded Oracle a contract on 2026-06-10 for a single governmentwide Core Human Capital Management platform to replace the more than 100 HR systems agencies use, to be implemented in phases. Trade reports put the contract at about $396 million over up to 10 years and list VA among eight first-wave agencies beginning the transition in FY2026, with governmentwide adoption targeted for FY2028. This is an OPM-led route rather than the VA acquisition the text describes, and no VA-specific migration schedule, contract or go-live date was found.

timeline.event: OPM awarded Oracle the Federal HRIT Modernization Core Human Capital Management contract for a single governmentwide HR platform to be implemented in phases (award date from news reports; the OPM release is undated).

title: Acquire a new human resources IT system for VA
uncertainties: The OPM release confirms the award and the phased consolidation but carries no date, contract value or agency list; the award date, value and term come from trade reports, and VA's place in the first wave comes from MeriTalk and FedWeek, not from an OPM or VA document. Whether the platform replaces VA's HR Smart system was not confirmed. VA published market research for its own cloud HCM platform in November 2024, before the period.
